katarapko.name: Katarapko–Pike floodplain, South Australia
katarapko.processing: Mask-aware 2x2 block mean of linear power (mask code 1 = valid), then 10*log10; same grid for all dates (identical CRS/transform verified).

comparability.registration_check: integer-pixel normalized correlation found 0 px offset in all windows (radar_audit.json)
caveats: A backscatter change is not by itself a flooding change
Regional reference targets also changed between dates (see radar_audit.json)

points.name: Pike River upstream Col Col Bank

everglades.name: Everglades Water Conservation Area 3A, Florida
everglades.product: NISAR L2 GUNW (provisional P05023, product 1.0.11), HH, 20 MHz
everglades.quantity: Interferometric coherence (0–1) and unwrapped phase (radians, relative to scene median) between two passes 12 days apart
everglades.processing: Harmony GeoTIFF subsets of the GUNW product; no resampling. Phase masked where connected component is 0 and shown relative to the scene median; no ionosphere, troposphere or tide correction applied.
everglades.phase_to_los_note: At L-band (~0.238 m wavelength) one 2π cycle of phase corresponds to ~11.9 cm of line-of-sight path change; phase is not converted to water level here.

phase.reference: scene median of unwrapped phase over pixels with a nonzero connected component
